reason: Whole Slide Images (WSIs) play an important role in accurate cancer prognosis and diagnosis, as they reveal the structure of organs at the cellular level. However, each WSI can be up to gigapixel resolution (e.g., $10,000 \times 10,000$ pixels), which poses challenges for storage and model training. Moreover, the number of WSIs is increasing rapidly, creating additional challenges for existing models to handle newly added data.
